skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Έδεμ
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Deck chairs/parasols and bars available; hotel rents sunbeds (~15€/person, 2023), rest of beach free with free toilets/showers.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Γαλάζια Ακτή
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Beach bar with sunbeds; entrance/sunbed pricing quoted (weekday minimum consumption 3€, sunbed 2.50€). Note: sources reference both Lagonisi and Schinias 'Galazia Akti' — both organized.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Κεντρική παραλία Σαρωνίδας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Central Saronida beach has 'umbrellas placed by the municipality'; the named beach bars (Alexander, Mavro Lithari) are on adjacent beaches, not the central one.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Σουβάλα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Souvala beach offers sunbeds, umbrellas, a beach bar and restaurant; nearby Loura beach also organized with umbrellas/sunbeds.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αυλάκι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Small pebble beach with cement sunbathing platform; umbrellas-sunbeds plus coffee/drinks/food provided by Castello housed directly above the beach.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Λιμνιώνας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Undeveloped and quiet overall, but 'σε ένα μόνο μικρό τμήμα υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες' and there is a small snack-bar.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Κομπονάδα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: In summer the beach has a canteen and sunbeds on one section ('διαθέτει καντίνα και ξαπλώστρες σε ένα κομμάτι της').

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Πόρτο Γερμενό
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Mostly free beach, but a small part is organized with umbrellas and loungers and the Punda Loca beach bar maintains loungers with umbrellas on the beach.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άγιος Αντώνιος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: psahno.com (local Psachna Evia guide): 'Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες' with cafeterias, beach bars and tavernas; some boilerplate-reuse risk noted.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άγιος Μηνάς
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: eviagreece: organized beach 3km from Chalkida offering umbrellas with loungers or cafes, popular with families; many tavernas/restaurants around.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Κρύας Βρύσης
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: North-Evia (Agia Anna extension) Krya Vrysi is described as 'οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες' with a shop on the beach serving coffee/ouzo; note there is also a Krya Vrysi near Karystos.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Φάρου
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Official bathing-water profile for Faros Avlidas: 'Τμήμα της παραλίας είναι οργανωμένο και διαθέτει... ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες' — assuming our Paralia Farou is the Avlida one (lighthouse at NE end).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Τσοκαΐτι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: eviagreece: Tsokaiti (Istiaia) has 'organized areas with loungers'; in earlier years canteens and beach bars provided loungers and umbrellas — present-tense sunbeds claimed, bar status uncertain.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άγιος Νικόλαος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Viotia beach guide: Agios Nikolaos has a large sandy beach where 'all day bar restaurants have set up umbrellas and loungers on the beach' with showers and food; reservation needed on August weekends.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Megali Ammos
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Megali Ammos (Ammouliani, Halkidiki): 'partially organized, featuring sunbeds and umbrellas, complemented by a tavern and a beach bar' — sunbeds via two beach bars (15€/set 2024 or free with order).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άγιος Γεώργιος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: At the eastern cove (Lichnistis) of Agios Georgios near Agia Galini there are rooms, a small taverna and umbrellas; area otherwise quiet/semi-wild.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Σπήλιες
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Spilies (Latzima, east of Rethymno) 'is organized with sunbeds, umbrellas and a canteen'.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Λυγιάς
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: travelpreveza.gr: beach described as not fully organized, but businesses on the beach offer free sunbeds and umbrellas for their customers.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Καλάμι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Visit Thesprotia: the adjacent camping provides sunbeds where you can enjoy coffee/snacks (Kalami between Igoumenitsa and Plataria).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Glyfa Beach
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: SuperTravel/projectcorfu: Glyfa (between Barbati and Nissaki, NE coast) has sunbeds & umbrellas, boat hire and a taverna restaurant.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Μώλος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Lovin' Corfu/discover-corfu: Molos (Lefkimmi Bay) is partly organized around the Attika Resort with sunbeds/umbrellas for rent, showers and a beach bar-restaurant; rest is unorganized.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αγία Παρασκευή
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr/terrabook: Agia Paraskevi (between Sami and Agia Efimia) has organized spots with sunbeds and beach bars, plus the Agia Paraskevi Beach Restaurant.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Βάτσα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: Vatsa Bay offers loungers and umbrellas plus beach bars serving drinks/light meals and water sports (kayak, ski).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Καμίνια
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: visitkefaloniaisland.gr: Kaminia (Ratzakli) has sunbeds and umbrellas (offered by the beach restaurant), while much of the 1.5 km beach stays free/unorganized.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Κουνόπετρα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Basic amenities on the beach: 'λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες', with tavernas/cafes a short distance away (feelgreece/terrabook).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Δεσίμι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Lefkada sources: Desimi is 'organized in a small part' with loungers, umbrellas and water sports; taverna and two campsites at its edges (other parts free/quiet).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Νικιάνας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: A section of Nikiana beach is organized with sunbeds and umbrellas (rest free for towels), tavernas/cafes in the village.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αμμούσα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Ammoussa is 'half-organized with loungers and umbrellas' rented from the taverna(s) by the beach, half free.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Λυγιά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: 'You will find umbrellas and sun loungers at Lygia Beach' (relaxed, lightly organized); SEATRAC installed; fish tavernas next to the beach.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Άγιος Ιωάννης
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Agrios Beach Bar, 'the most organized beach bar of Meganisi', operates on Spartochori's central beach (Agios Ioannis) with regular/special loungers, poufs and beds.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αμπούλα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Ampoula (Tragaki/Tsilivi side) is a very small Blue Flag beach 'partly serviced with umbrellas and sunbeds' placed on the strip just behind the beach.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Δάφνη
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Dafni (Marine Park turtle-nesting beach): own umbrellas are forbidden, but the beach tavernas (Petalida etc.) offer sunbeds and umbrellas, some free with consumption.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Καλαμάκι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Kalamaki beach has umbrellas and sunbeds (limited to a few spots due to Marine Park turtle-nesting rules); showers/changing rooms per some guides.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Σαρακήνικο
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Ithaca municipality/guides: Sarakiniko has 'a few loungers and umbrellas as well as a canteen that offers essentials'.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Λούτσα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Loutsa (Vathy) 'διαθέτει κάποια οργάνωση, με λίγες ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες προς ενοικίαση' plus a canteen; Blue Flag.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Φιλιατρό (Κιόνι)
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Filiatro is an organized beach with umbrellas/sunbeds for rent covering half its length and a beach bar for coffee, water and fast food.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αμμουδέλι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Lesvos beach guide: the small sandy beach 300m from Plomari square is organized with umbrellas and sun loungers and quite popular.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Φαρά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Wikipedia (Blue Flag 2025): in summer a canteen operates at Fara offering free loungers and shade under mastic trees.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Χαλατσές
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Official bathing water profile: not formally organized but has showers, changing rooms, umbrellas and loungers plus a refreshment stand on the beach.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Μύλων
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Myloi beach is organized with bather facilities — umbrellas, showers, changing rooms, bins; seafront tavernas and cafes in the village.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Ζαρίτσι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Zaritsi (Tyros) is partially organized with beach bars for coffee/drinks and tavernas; the organized Zaritsi Camping operates beside it.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Βερβένων
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Kato Vervena / Paliochano beach: a canteen mid-beach offers plenty of loungers and umbrellas, with ample free space for own equipment.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Πούλιθρα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Poulithra's pebble beach is partly organized — sunbeds available on a section of the beach, with tavernas along the shore.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Αγία Βαρβάρα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Skoutari/Agia Varvara beach (Lakonia): 'Σε κάποια σημεία θα βρείτε ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες, ενώ στην περιοχή λειτουργούν εστιατόρια και ταβέρνες' — partial sunbed coverage.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Κότρωνα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Kotronas is called 'one of the most well-known and organized beaches in Laconian Mani': 'There are some sun loungers and showers, and there are shops for food and coffee around the area.'

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Πεταλίδι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: 'Petalidi is an organized beach with crystal-clear waters and all facilities near the village' with a promenade of tavernas and cafes; sunbeds not explicitly itemized (beach also has a Seatrac and accessibility infrastructure per our data).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Καμπί
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Kea's Kambi is described as organized mainly on its right side with umbrellas, sunbeds, showers and cabins from a beach bar, plus a taverna on the road above.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Απόλλωνας
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Village beach of Apollonas described as organized with umbrellas and loungers, surrounded by tavernas and cafes.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Μουτσούνα
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: The Moutsouna bay hosts two beaches, one of which is described as fully organized with sunbeds, umbrellas, lifeguard, changing rooms and showers.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Πυργάκι
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Guides state Pyrgaki has umbrellas and sunbeds ('διαθέτει ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες') alongside its quiet shallow-water character.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Όρμος Υστερνίων
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Travel piece on Ormos Ysternion Tinos: visitors sit 'κάτω από τα αλμυρίκια και τις ψάθινες ομπρέλες' — straw umbrellas on the beach, fish tavernas right on the water; no explicit sunbed rental mention.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Λιμάνι Παναγιάς
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Municipality of Karpathos lists Limani Panagias (Lefkos) as 'Organized beach with umbrellas and taverns'; other guides note it has a few umbrellas and sunbeds (not enough for everyone).

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Προτοκάραβος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Protokaravos (Kefalos, Kos) 'is organized with umbrellas and sunbeds in some areas', divided into two sections, otherwise quiet and wild.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Λεύκες
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Patmosweb on Lefkes: 'Λίγο πριν τον Κάμπο (Υπάρχει καντίνα)' — a canteen operates at the beach; no sunbeds/umbrellas mentioned.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Πλατανίτη
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Nafpaktia municipality/local guides describe Platanitis (4 km from the Rio-Antirrio bridge) as organized with restaurants, cafes and sunbeds.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: ΠΔΕ Πάτρα Αγ.Βασίλειος
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Agios Vasileios (Rio, Patras) described as largely organized with umbrellas and loungers, beach bars along the coast, plus a Seatrac access ramp.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Λεβεντοχωρίου
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Pyrgos hoteliers/Visit Olympia listings: beach has umbrellas, loungers, WC, showers and a canteen with tables serving swimmers.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Γλυφά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Glyfa (Alonissos) has fine white pebble and umbrellas with sunbeds at its southern end.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Παραλία Βότση
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Votsi cove described as organized with umbrellas and sunbeds; tavernas in the small harbor village.

skippedMediumNoCore.name: Τσουκαλιά
skippedMediumNoCore.evidence: Tsoukalia (largest north-side beach) has a few sunbeds and umbrellas plus a canteen for essentials.
